thread:
anika: quick thread to capture tradeoffs from today's design sync — we need a clear path for hierarchical quotas + probabilistic shedding to avoid noisy-subclient cartwheels.
ben: agreed. core problem: tenants contain many sub-clients (api keys, users). If we only track tenant-level quotas, a single noisy api_key can starve others. If we track every api_key we explode state.
sophie: proposal: two-layer accounting. long_term_bucket = tenant_id (billing + guarantees). short_term_fairness = per-identity fingerprint with configurable resolution. admission uses both: charge tenant bucket but use fairness_shard to decide immediate shed.
raj: how to compute fingerprint? hashed(api_key || session_id || ip) with configurable salt. Salt lets us rotate to avoid warm-cache attacks. Also support optional route tag for per-endpoint hotspots.
anika: important: fingerprint must not affect kvcache keys. kvcache_key = canonical_cache_prefix (tenant + model + prefix). fairness_shard must be decoupled so caching unaffected.\b en: typo but OK
ben: note: we should sample fingerprint at ingress and attach fairness_shard to request metadata. Downstream admission can use reservoir counters per shard. Reservoir size tuned by SLO targets.
sophie: on probabilistic shedding: rather than hard-deny on override, prefer probability p that ramps up with abuse_score. That avoids collateral damage on shared NATs. Ops asked for instant blocks sometimes — we can support short TTL hard blocks but default to soft shed.
raj: telemetry: emit fields: tiered_charge=tenant_bucket, fairness_shard, shed_mode={soft,hard,prob}, abuse_score, override_origin. This lets us backfill sims.
anika: API contract sketch: Frontdoor -> Admission: {canonical_id, cache_key_hint, model, route, token_estimate, fingerprint_hint(optional)} Admission -> Frontdoor: {decision: {admit|soft_shed|hard_deny}, reason, new_ttl_if_override, suggested_backoff_ms}. Keep tiny.\ben: edge case: what about quota exhaustion vs abuse? We must separate counters: quota_counter decremented only on admitted requests; abuse_override should not deduct quota when it causes soft_shed — or it will double penalize. Need explicit flags: override_applies_to_admit_only.
sophie: agree. Add flag "dont_charge_on_override" when SRE triggers emergency sheds. Also audit log with incident id.
raj: ops-bot: test note — simulated shared-NAT in staging: hard block -> 27% false positive; soft_shed -> latency increase but far fewer false positives. Suggest default soft.
infra-bot: /deploy note: canary rollout of probabilistic-shed logic scheduled Fri 03:00 UTC to region-us-east-1.
anika: action items: 1) Sophie will draft appendix on fingerprint derivation + salt rotation (due Thu). 2) Ben will open Admission API PR with compact JSON schema (due Mon). 3) Raj will run charge vs fairness sims and post results (due next Wed). 4) Ops to produce playbook entries for hard-block exceptions (owner: ops, due two weeks).
ben: small perf note — storing reservoir counters per fairness_shard at ingress keeps latency low; global counters can be approximated via sketches if needed. I'll include perf numbers in the PR.
anika: thanks all. If no objections in 48h I'll merge this into the admission-refactor epic and update the design board. :thumbsup:
